latestSnapshot.readme: This dataset consists of 6-hour long EEG recordings in wildtype (WT) and rats Syngap+/Δ−GAP (HET) rats (male, 12-16 weeks old) starting at zeitgeber time (ZT) 3 to 9 (under a 12 light hr:12 dark hr schedule with lights on at 07:00 am). Associated with each rat is two 6-hour recording files, expect for those which only underwent one recording session (S7020, , S7025, S7030, S7031, S7032, 39, S7040, S7041). Recordings were acquired with an OpenEphys acquisition system (OpenEphys, Portugal) and head-mounted 32-channel EEG array probe (H32-EEG—NeuroNexus, USA) with accelerometers (NeuroNexus, USA), at a sampling rate of 1 kHz. For more detailed methods, please see our associated publication doi: 10.1016/j.celrep.2024.114733.
